name: @pipeworx/mcp-shovels

tools.name: shovels_address_search
tools.description: Resolve a US address to Shovels records, each carrying a `geo_id` — the geolocation ID you pass to shovels_permits_search / shovels_contractors_search to scope those queries. Results are ordered by relevance in USPS notation. Example: shovels_address_search({ q: "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington DC", _apiKey: "your-key" })

q.description: The text to search for in address fields, e.g. "123 Main St, Austin TX" or a partial address.

size.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default 50).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response `next_cursor`.

_apiKey.description: Shovels API key (X-API-Key). Sign up at https://app.shovels.ai/create-account/

tools.name: shovels_permits_search
tools.description: Search US building permits scoped to a location. Requires a `geo_id` (a US state code like "CA", a ZIP code, or a Shovels geo_id from shovels_address_search) plus a permit date range (permit_from / permit_to, YYYY-MM-DD). Monetary values (job_value, fees, market value) are returned in both cents and dollars. Example: shovels_permits_search({ geo_id: "CA", permit_from: "2024-01-01", permit_to: "2024-12-31", property_type: "residential", _apiKey: "your-key" })

geo_id.description: Location scope: a US state code ("CA"), a ZIP code ("94103"), or a Shovels geo_id from shovels_address_search.

permit_from.description: Return permits that started on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

permit_to.description: Return permits that started on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

permit_tags.description: Filter by work-type tags (e.g. ["solar","roofing"]). Prefix a tag with "-" to exclude it.

permit_status.description: Filter by status: final, in_review, inactive, active.

permit_q.description: Free-text search over permit descriptions (max 50 chars).

property_type.description: Filter by property type: residential, commercial, industrial, etc.

permit_min_job_value.description: Minimum permit job value, in CENTS (dollars × 100).

contractor_name.description: Filter permits by contractor name (partial match, min 3 chars).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response `next_cursor`.

include_count.description: Include an approximate total_count on the first page (default false).

_apiKey.description: Shovels API key (X-API-Key). Sign up at https://app.shovels.ai/create-account/

tools.name: shovels_contractors_search
tools.description: Search US construction contractors scoped to a location, with license, work history and aggregate job value. Requires a `geo_id` (state code, ZIP, or Shovels geo_id from shovels_address_search) plus a permit date range (permit_from / permit_to, YYYY-MM-DD). Job-value fields are returned in both cents and dollars. Example: shovels_contractors_search({ geo_id: "94103", permit_from: "2023-01-01", permit_to: "2024-12-31", contractor_name: "solar", _apiKey: "your-key" })

geo_id.description: Location scope: a US state code ("CA"), a ZIP code ("94103"), or a Shovels geo_id from shovels_address_search.

permit_from.description: Consider permits that started on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

permit_to.description: Consider permits that started on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

contractor_name.description: Filter by contractor name (partial match, min 3 chars).

contractor_classification_derived.description: Filter by derived contractor classification/specialty. Prefix with "-" to exclude.

permit_tags.description: Filter by work-type tags of the contractor’s permits. Prefix "-" to exclude.

property_type.description: Filter by property type: residential, commercial, industrial, etc.

contractor_min_total_job_value.description: Minimum total job value across the contractor’s permits, in CENTS.

contractor_min_total_permits_count.description: Minimum number of permits the contractor has.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response `next_cursor`.

include_count.description: Include an approximate total_count on the first page (default false).

_apiKey.description: Shovels API key (X-API-Key). Sign up at https://app.shovels.ai/create-account/

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-shovels forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the shovels pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
